name: Enterprise Objectives, Targets and Value Assessment

constraintRules.text: WM-KNW-011 is profiled for objective, key-result and target roles without creating another root.
Key Result requires an additive exact Metric Definition revision pin absent from WM-KNW-011 fd-measure-binding plus quantitative target parameters; an unresolvable pin is rejected.
Metric change creates a traceable successor binding and never silently rebases history.

WM-XCT-025 is a usage reference restricted to a candidate WM-MAT-008 observation host, not a settled catalogue relation, profile base or standalone record; Claude's unassigned-host alternative remains open.
WM-ACT-034 Value Assessment cites Benefits, Disbenefits, Outcomes and observations by reference and pins valuation profile and method.
Assessment may abstain for insufficient evidence or incomparable scales and never treats delivery acceptance as evidence.
